1486-4231-4875-5400--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.

Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Synth Infiltrator. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability.

When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
